purpose: ADR-077 (04.10.2026): the search plan and the selection work for the current message only. In the live questionnaire of 04.10.2026 one conversation asked five unrelated legal questions in a row (Q9-Q13). From the third message on the plan searched the earlier, answered questions again and joined their subjects into the query for the current one; from the second message on the selection kept passages about earlier questions; the fifth turn's evidence was mostly about the earlier subjects and its answer was unsupported. The same five messages, word for word. Each later turn checks what the plan set out to find and what the selection kept; the last one also checks that the Family Law Act, the legal basis of the maintenance duty, is found and cited (in the clean repeat R13 two of its passages were candidates and neither was selected). Written before any run with the model. Run with --auto-modes (what the chat sends).

expectation_help.plan_queries_must_not: search: none of the plan's queries is about an earlier message's subject (subsistence, reporting a child in need, guardianship, severity of disability). A query that joins an earlier subject to the current one fails as well
expectation_help.selected_must_not: search: none of the passages the selection kept is from a source whose title names an earlier message's subject. A title is a coarse sign: an act that serves several subjects (the Social Welfare Act) is not named here
expectation_help.region: state: these are general questions, no municipal scope is chosen
expectation_help.evidence / cited: the act that answers the turn's question is among the found sources and the answer has a source block that cites it; an answer that only asks back or says it cannot tell cites nothing
expectation_help.must: answer: it speaks of the current question's subject. Read the whole answer as well, a pattern is a coarse check

history: 04.10.2026, first run (commit eb71cf9b, search-assist-7): the catalogue as written before any run, 5 turns: 2 passed, 2 search, 1 answer, 0.0255 USD. Turn 3: the plan searched both earlier questions again (the selection kept none of their passages). Turn 4: the act was found and selected, the answer cited a study alone. Turn 5: plan and selection clean, but no passage of the Family Law Act on the maintenance duty was a candidate: its two reserved candidates were sections on guardianship (docs/audits/evidence/search-assist-7-measured-2026-10-04.json).

Turn 3: the plan searched both earlier questions again, as before. Turn 4 passed. Turn 5: still no passage of the Family Law Act on maintenance among the candidates (its two were § 191 and § 192), so the earlier messages were not the cause (docs/audits/evidence/search-6-measured-2026-10-04.json).

04.10.2026, third run (commit fa56b2f1, search-assist-8, ADR-079): 5 turns: 3 passed, 2 search, 0.0252 USD. Turn 3: three queries again, one per message. Turn 5: one query for the duty itself, twelve passages of the Family Law Act among the candidates but not § 96 or § 97; the answer states the maintenance duty from an article (docs/audits/evidence/search-assist-8-measured-2026-10-04.json).

04.10.2026, fourth run (commit 9aabbf6f, ADR-080): 5 turns: 5 passed, 0.0257 USD. Every plan wrote one query; the third turn did so by itself, so ADR-080's rule did not act. Turn 1 gave the amounts (the budget act's passage with the amount was a candidate this time). Turn 5: § 97, § 99 and § 103 of the Family Law Act were selected and cited (docs/audits/evidence/plan-guard-measured-2026-10-04.json).

scenarios.title: Viis üksteisega sidumata õigusküsimust samas vestluses

turns.text: Kui suur on toimetulekupiir ja kuidas toimetulekutoetust arvutatakse?
turns.note: The first message: nothing earlier to search again. Since corpus v49 the amount has a national source (ADR-076); it is measured by scenarios-national-sources-1 and not required here.

turns.text: Kes peab teatama abivajavast lapsest ja kuhu?
turns.note: 04.10 (Q10): the plan's three queries were all about reporting a child in need and the answer was grounded, but the selection kept a passage of an article on subsistence benefit.

turns.text: Mis vahe on eestkostel ja toetatud otsustamisel?
turns.note: 04.10 (Q11): the first turn whose plan had the fault. Two of the three queries searched the first and the second question again; the selection kept passages on subsistence benefit and on reporting a child in need.

04.10 (Q12): two queries searched earlier questions again and the third joined guardianship to the severity of disability. The act was not in the index then; as a first message on corpus v49 the turn found and cited it (scenarios-national-sources-1).

turns.text: Kas hooldekodu kohatasu võib nõuda lastelt?
turns.note: 04.10 (Q13): all three queries carried earlier subjects, the selection kept passages on reporting a child and on the severity of disability, and the answer was unsupported. As a first message (R13) the plan's two queries were about the care home fee and the maintenance duty, two passages of the Family Law Act were candidates, neither was selected, and the answer said the basis of the children's duty stayed unconfirmed. Which passages they were is not in that record; from search-assist-7 on the record keeps each candidate's first words.
